:::{#def-first-order-logic}
#### First-order logic

**First-order logic**
[@wikipedia_first_order_logic]
extends propositional logic (@def-propositional-logic)
by also allowing:

- variables $x, y, \ldots$ that stand for elements of a [set](sets.qmd#def-set);
- [predicates](#def-predicate) of one or more of those variables,
  such as $P(x)$ or $x < y$;
- [functions](functions.qmd#def-function) of them, such as $x + y$;
- equality between them;
- [quantifiers](#def-quantifier) $\forall$ and $\exists$ over them.

:::
